{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#lem-second-moment-variance}

#### The second moment is the variance plus the squared mean

For any [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $Z$ with $\E{Z^2} < \infty$:

$$\E{Z^2} = \var{Z} + \sqf{\E{Z}}$$

:::

::: proof

Add $\sqf{\E{Z}}$ to both sides of the
[simplified expression for variance](#thm-variance),
$\var{Z} = \E{Z^2} - \sqf{\E{Z}}$.

:::
